relationships.subject: compound 50
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, molecular docking results showed that compound 50 formed 2 hydrogen bonds and π-π stacking interactions with amino acid residues in the lipid exposed pocket of Nav1.7.

relationships.subject: compound 50
relationships.evidence_quote: Further in vivo studies showed that compound 50 had a faster onset of action and better analgesic efficacy in several pain models than positive control.

key_findings: Novel arylsulfonamide compound 50 is a selective Nav1.7 inhibitor with good microsomal stability, low hERG risk and better analgesic efficacy and faster onset than positive control in pain models.
Docking shows compound 50 forms two hydrogen bonds and pi-pi stacking in the lipid-exposed pocket of Nav1.7.
